profile.headline: Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary: A career professional working with many years experience in leadership, sales, physical security, law enforcement, plant operations, and human resources. Possessing superior interpersonal skills as well as keen attention to detail. I’m always looking for ways to contribute to the overall success of any organization including finding opportunities for growth. I'm currently working as a Software Engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship QA Department
positions.description:
I'm a senior at New England Institute of Technology. As an Software Engineering Major, I'm fascinated how technology shapes our world. 

I'm currently working as an intern in the Quality Assurance Department at IGT. My responsibilities are as follows. 

• Update Stored Procedures using Microsoft SQL Server to provide production hours and requirements for current projects. 

• Compile historical data with actual and forecast results for system delivery projects at the Production, Quality Assurance, and testing levels. 

• Generate SQL queries from the Data Warehouse to provide a complete overview of the Project Development Lifecycle's. 

• Update reports, charts, graphs using SQL Server Data Tools to display production data.

Skills and Requirements:

• Microsoft SQL Server
• Java 
• SQL Server Data Tools 
• Microsoft Excel

company.name: IGT (formerly GTECH), a subsidiary of International Game Technology PLC

positions.title: Senior Recruiter
positions.description:
• Led and managed a recruiting office seeking qualified personnel for service in the United States Navy.  
• Directed all administrative processes, human resource policies, procedures, laws, regulations, and deadlines. 
• Developed and implemented recruiting strategies to achieve monthly and annual recruiting goals. 
• Managed, mentored & led 200 personnel awaiting recruit training ensuring shipping goals were met or exceeded. Coordinated office training to ensure long-range organizational planning was met. 
• Directly managed $200,000 in equipment to include marketing tools, vehicles, computers, and office equipment.
• Awarded medium station award for obtaining 145% above previous goals.

positions.title: MASTER-AT-ARMS/Operations Section Supervisor
positions.description:
• Led, trained and supervised 83 personnel security detachment conducting anti- terrorism/force protection operations to include Law Enforcement.
• Provided security and logistic support to Naval Central Command and Fifth Fleet Units in support of Operations Enduring Freedom and Operations Iraqi Freedom. 
• Conduct specialized duties in the investigation of military offenses with emphasis on knowledge of military and civilian legal considerations. Collect and preserve physical and testimonial evidence. Maintain liaison with NCIS, CID, USMC, USA, USAF and host nation counterparts.
• Planned and executed multiple detailed Force Protection plans for numerous high level distinguished visitors to include U.S. Secretary of State, Secretary of Defense, Joint Chief of Staff, Commander Central Command and the Chief of Naval Operations.
• Conducted over 100 physical security inspections for the Navy Facility and Housing office to ensure local realtors where in compliance with the Navy’s Force Protection Policy.
